topic.lq25-the-beast.speaker: npc.hist-heartland.helstrom.lq25-crew-poler
topic.lq25-the-beast.prompt: Why is the crew not out on the river?
lines: A crocodile lairs in the shallows under our plank walk. It took one of our rafts. Now no crew member will take a raft out.
The plank walk runs along the shore beside our houses. The beast lies in the water beneath it.
Kill it for us. Then we can work the river again.
lines@low: A crocodile lairs in the shallows under our plank walk. It took a raft. No one on the crew will take a raft out now.
The plank walk runs along the shore beside our houses. The beast lies in the water beneath it.
Kill it. Then we can work the river again. I ask no more of you than that.
lines@high: I am glad you asked, friend. A crocodile lairs in the shallows under our plank walk. It took one of our rafts.
Now no one on the crew will take a raft out. The walk runs along the shore beside our houses. The beast lies in the water beneath it.
Kill it for us, and we can work the river again. I trust you with this.

topic.lq25-tell-captain.speaker: npc.hist-heartland.helstrom.boat-captain
topic.lq25-tell-captain.prompt: I found this bucket under the crew's plank walk.
lines: That is the landing crew's bucket. It is full of offal. I believed the beast had always been there. This proves it was not.
You have done me a great service. Take 60 gold for it.
Now I will take my trade back on the river.

topic.lq25-keep-quiet.speaker: npc.hist-heartland.helstrom.lq25-crew-steerer
topic.lq25-keep-quiet.prompt: I know about the offal under your plank walk.
lines: Yes. We dumped it there to draw a beast and scare the boat captain's trade off the river.
If the boat captain hears of this, she will take all the river trade for herself. Say nothing to her.
Here are 40 gold. It is a small price, but it is what we can pay.
